files.folderSet: Folder “{name}” will be used for the files.
files.noAscent: No ascent started yet – no files.
map.unavailable: Map unavailable (no internet or map library not loaded).
login.tagline: Sonde launch with Windsond S2 / RR4 · Wicki Partners Balloon Team
login.note: Accounts are issued by the master user. Every login and every step of a sonde ascent is logged in the background. After 2 h without activity a new login is required.
login.browsers: Chrome or Edge · Windows laptop and Android tablet
login.badCredentials: User name or password is wrong.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts – please wait a minute.
login.setupText: There is no user yet. Create the master user now – user name and password are free to choose.
plan.startHintRr4: RR4 GPS: {sats} satellites. “Pick on map” opens a map with crosshair and place search.
plan.startHintMap: Taken from the map. Ground elevation from the terrain model.
plan.timeHint: 10-minute steps · LT = local time at the launch site · {date} {lt} LT = {utc} UTC
plan.burstText: The sonde rises until the balloon bursts: computed {alt} (from balloon, fill and payload). The trajectory is computed up to there. A manual cutdown remains possible at any time (as long as the sonde is properly connected).
plan.noCutConfirm: I confirm: no automatic cutdown, ascent to ≈ {alt} m AMSL
plan.srcNote: Weather: {src} · airspace: sample data (openAIP to follow) · rise rate {rise} m/s. Change in the ☰ menu top right.
plan.mapNote: Map: OSM, satellite: Esri · planning aid only – check DABS/NOTAM
plan.grossLift: Required gross lift · balloon alone, without sonde
plan.liftNote: for {rise} m/s · gas ≈ {gas} L · with sonde ({payload} g) ≈ {net} g net lift remain
plan.fix1: Lower the cutdown height to {alt} (suggestion) – or
plan.fix2: Shift the launch time (the wind turns over time) – or
plan.fix4b: and continue anyway: you confirm that you have checked the airspace and are aware of the risks.
plan.banner.conflict: CAUTION! – The planned trajectory crosses airspace {name} from {alt} m AMSL
plan.banner.confirmTitle: No automatic cutdown selected – confirmation required
plan.banner.confirmSub: Tick “I confirm” at the bottom left, otherwise “Next” stays locked.
plan.banner.ok: OK – trajectory computed, no airspace conflict
plan.banner.okSub: Landing point about {dist} km towards {brg}, total duration about {min} min. You can go on to prepare the sonde.
plan.status.airspace: trajectory computed · airspace warning open (the step stays yellow until you fix it or consciously ignore it)
plan.status.ignored: trajectory computed · airspace warning consciously ignored
plan.expert.title: Expert: rise rate, descent rate, model, export
startort.title: Pick the launch site on the map
startort.searchPh: Search a place, e.g. Katzenrüti, Rümlang
startort.dragHint: Drag the map with finger or mouse until the crosshair is on the launch site
startort.noGps: No location received from the device.
prep.rx.howTo: Connect the RR4 with the USB cable and press “Connect”.
prep.rx.noSerial: This browser cannot talk to USB devices (Web Serial). Use Chrome or Edge on the laptop.
prep.sd.howTo: Plug the black cable into RR4 and S2 and wait about 5 s.
prep.bl.ready: Balloon with ≈ {g} g gross lift ready
prep.ob.visible: This ascent is visible there under “Follow sonde ascent”
prep.ob.notConnected: Connection to s2stueve not established yet
prep.ob.retrying: retrying in the background – the ascent works without it
prep.p.sonde: Plug the sonde into the RR4
prep.p.written: Transfer the plan to the sonde
prep.status.ok: Sonde programmed. Sonde and balloon ready.
prep.banner.openIntro: What you need to do now:
prep.banner.ok: OK – sonde programmed. Sonde and balloon ready.
prep.banner.okSub: Receiver and sonde are connected, the plan has been transferred to the sonde. You can go on to the checks.
prep.written.title: Data written to the sonde
prep.written.readBack: Read back from the sonde at {time} UTC – matches. Change: in the ☰ menu top right.
prep.written.noSonde: As soon as a sonde is detected, cutdown height and ground pressure are transferred.
prep.expert.title: Expert: change settings, radio, connection
prep.expert.dropHint: Drop can only be selected when a dropsonde is detected on the cable; the sonde type is read automatically
prep.expert.cutAlt: Cutdown height above ground (overrides the plan)
prep.expert.groundPressure: Include ground elevation in the pressure calibration
prep.expert.radioNote: Read-only for all other users (fields locked). Every change is logged.
prep.expert.relay: Link to s2stueve (only needed in exceptional cases)
prep.expert.storage: Data storage (in addition to the app)
prep.expert.folder: Folder – default from the master user settings
prep.expert.storageNote: Per ascent, CSV, .sounding and KML are stored there (Dropbox syncs). Allow access once in the browser (Chrome/Edge); on the Android tablet the files go to the Downloads folder.
prep.expert.observersNote: Observers sign in to s2stueve with their personal access code (Master user · Observers) and see the running ascent automatically.
prep.expert.program: Transfer changed settings to the sonde
prep.expert.programNote: The app reads all values back and only shows “OK” above when they match.
mode.init: waiting for GPS fix · LED 2× / 5 s
chk.title: Check items – run automatically
chk.radio.noPackets: no packets – switch the sonde on, check distance to the RR4
chk.radio.lossy: {pct} % packet loss – check the position of RR4 and sonde
chk.gps.waiting: waiting for satellites ({have} of {need} needed) – hold the sonde outdoors
chk.rxgps.ok: position known, launch site taken over
chk.bat.low: {v} V – enough for a short ascent; charging recommended
chk.bat.bad: {v} V – too low, charge the sonde
chk.sens.wait: values not plausible yet – wait a few seconds
chk.wire.failed: test failed – check the wire connection
chk.set.mismatch: differ from the plan – transfer again in phase 2
chk.obs.off: no connection to s2stueve (ascent still possible)
chk.status.ok: ready for launch – all items green
chk.status.open: not ready for launch – {n} of {total} items open
chk.banner.open: Not ready for launch – {n} of {total} items open
chk.banner.todo: What you need to do now:
chk.banner.ok: Ready for launch – all items green
chk.banner.okSub: The sonde blinks once per second. Press “RELEASE LAUNCH” and let go of the sonde – it detects the launch itself.
chk.step.gps2: , antenna down, clear view of the sky – GPS reception takes 0.5 to 2 minutes. The item turns green by itself.
chk.step.wire2: and hold the sonde in your hand meanwhile (the string is not cut).
chk.step.radio: Establish the radio link: keep the RR4 connected, sonde switched on, distance below 50 m.
chk.step.settings: Transfer the settings to the sonde again in phase 2.
chk.step.battery: Charge the sonde or use a charged sonde.
chk.waitLed: Sonde blinks 2× every 5 s = not ready yet
chk.startHint: As soon as everything is green, the sonde blinks once per second and the button below becomes active. The sonde detects the launch itself – after the release simply let go.
chk.releaseNote: becomes active when all {n} items are green
chk.releaseReady: all items green – release the launch and let go of the sonde
chk.released: Launch released – let go of the sonde
chk.releasedToast: Launch released. Let go of the sonde – the ascent is detected automatically.
chk.expert.title: Expert: measurements behind the check items
asc.status.running: ascent in progress – data goes live to s2stueve
asc.banner.waitTitle: Waiting for the launch – let go of the sonde
asc.banner.waitSub: The sonde detects the launch itself; recording starts once it is 35 m above ground.
asc.banner.lostSub: Place the RR4 antenna in the open, away from metal. The sonde keeps transmitting; as soon as a packet arrives, this continues.
asc.banner.landedSub: Continue to “Retrieve sonde” for navigation and QR code.
asc.banner.descTitle: Cutdown triggered at {alt} m above ground – sonde descending
asc.banner.descSub: descent rate {rate} m/s · the landing position is updated continuously
asc.banner.runTitle: OK – ascent running for {since}, data goes live to s2stueve
asc.banner.autoCut: automatic cutdown at {alt} m above ground
asc.noData: No data from the sonde yet.
asc.radioGood: Link good · sonde transmits every second
asc.cutdownNote: asks once · the sonde acknowledges by radio · is logged
asc.cutdownConfirm: Trigger the cutdown now? The sonde is at {alt} m above ground. The action is logged.
asc.cutdownSent: Cutdown command sent – the sonde acknowledges by radio.
asc.cutdownGround: Note: the sonde is still on the ground (test cutdown).
asc.cutdownEvent: Sonde reports cutdown at {alt} m above ground.
asc.expert.title: Expert: radio, position, raw data, files
detail.title: Detail view
vert.aria: Vertical profile: altitude over distance from launch with terrain, airspaces, planned and actual profile
stueve.aria: Stüve diagram: isobars with pressure and altitude, isotherms, dry and moist adiabats, temperature and dew point curves, wind barbs
chat.title: Chat with observers
chat.quick: Quick replies · set by the master user
chat.placeholder: Write a message to observers / crew …
ret.overviewNote: Map: OSM, satellite: Esri · my position from the device
ret.ageOk: sonde keeps transmitting on the ground
ret.ageWeak: radio weak on the ground – drive closer, take the receiver along
ret.qr.title: Hand over to the phone
ret.qr.text: Scan – Google Maps navigation to the landing site starts directly
ret.qr.textEst: Scan – navigation to the estimated landing point
ret.banner.noPosSub: No radio packet with a GPS position has been received yet.
ret.banner.okTitle: Sonde landed – position known, {dist} km from here
ret.banner.okSub: Last radio packet {age} ago; the sonde keeps transmitting on the ground while the battery lasts (about {h} h). Ascent data has been sent to s2stueve.
ret.banner.lostTitle: Position possibly inaccurate – radio signal lost during the descent
ret.banner.lostSub: Last packet {time} UTC at {agl} m AGL; the landing point is estimated from descent rate and wind (uncertainty about ± {acc} m).
ret.banner.takeRx: Take the RR4 receiver along and keep it switched on
ret.banner.lostSub2: – the radio search continues; as soon as a packet arrives, position, map and QR code jump to the real location.
ret.archiveText: CSV, .sounding and KML are written out, the live session is ended and the app is reset for the next ascent.
ret.expert.title: Expert: radio search, last packets, files
admin.title: Users & log
admin.subtitle: Administration · master user only
admin.s.relay: Relay for s2stueve (live data & chat) – empty = Worker address from src/config.js
admin.s.rr4usb: RR4 hardware ID (USB VID/PID) – detected automatically on first connect
admin.s.cloudRh: Cloud threshold RH for shading in the Stüve
admin.s.windFallback: Fallback wind when Open-Meteo is unreachable (direction / m/s)
admin.quick: Quick replies in the chat (buttons) – master user only
admin.quickNote: max. 6 buttons per side · free text is always possible
asc.cutdownLanded: The sonde has landed – the cutdown wire is not fired again.
asc.cutdownConfirmGround: The sonde is still on the ground. The cutdown wire is only heated briefly (test, 150 ms). Trigger anyway? The action is logged.
plan.status.noAirspace: Airspace data unavailable – check DABS/NOTAM manually
plan.banner.noAirspaceTitle: Airspace data unavailable – trajectory without airspace check
plan.airspace.noKey: No openAIP key is stored. The master user enters it under Master → App settings (the same key as in s2planning).
plan.airspace.badKey: openAIP rejected the stored key. Check it under Master → App settings.
plan.airspace.unreachable: openAIP cannot be reached at the moment (internet? service?).
plan.airspace.step1: Check the airspaces along the trajectory by hand (DABS, NOTAM, ICAO chart).
plan.airspace.step2: Press “Reload” later – as soon as the data is available the app checks automatically.
admin.s.keySet: key is stored – leave empty to keep it
admin.s.keyMissing: no key yet – paste it here
admin.s.openaipHint: Free at openaip.net → account → API key. Stored on the server only, never sent to the browser.
admin.s.airspaceCats: Airspace categories that count as a conflict
prep.ob.kickText: The connection is closed and access to this ascent is blocked. The access code stays valid (revoke: Master user · Observers).
prep.notify.title: Notify observers (WhatsApp)
prep.notify.intro: Each button opens WhatsApp with the standard message (launch time, site, cutdown, frequency, access code) – just press “Send”.
prep.notify.autoFailed: automatic send failed – please send manually
obs.title: Observers · access codes
obs.intro: Observers need no password: they sign in to s2stueve (“Follow sonde ascent”) with their 6-character code, choose a display name and may write in the chat. Hardware actions (cutdown) stay with the ground station.
obs.label: Label
obs.whatsappNotify: notify about new ascents by WhatsApp
obs.noLogins: No login with this code yet.
obs.createdText: Hand this code to the observer. It stays valid until revoked here and is also listed in the table.
obs.mobileFormat: Mobile number in international format, e.g. +41 79 123 45 67
obs.revokeText: The observer is logged out immediately and can no longer sign in with this code. It can be reactivated at any time.
admin.usersNote: Ground-station users have a login name and password. Master users may additionally manage users, observer codes and app settings.
admin.s.waPhoneNumberId: WhatsApp Cloud API – phone number ID (stage 2, optional)
admin.s.waToken: WhatsApp Cloud API – access token (stage 2, optional)
admin.s.waHint: Only needed for automatic sending (Meta business account, see README “WhatsApp”). Without these fields the buttons in phase 2 open WhatsApp with the prepared message.
quick.subtitle: Quick start
quick.pill: Start the sonde right here · no planning
quick.toFull: Full view (map, vertical view, Stüve, chat) →
quick.btn.title: Start the sonde right here
quick.btn.sub: no planning · one page · only the essentials
quick.title: Start the sonde right here
quick.intro: Three steps. The app sets up everything else itself, records and sends live to s2stueve.
quick.rx.label: Receiver RR4 on the USB cable –
quick.sd.batLow: Battery too weak – charge the sonde or use a charged one.
quick.start.device: Start = {here} (this device’s GPS – provisional only, the receiver has no fix yet) ·
quick.start.fix: Put the receiver outdoors so it can determine its position – no start without the receiver’s GPS fix.
quick.cut.label: Cutdown altitude above ground
quick.cut.minus: Lower the cutdown altitude by 500 m
quick.cut.plus: Raise the cutdown altitude by 500 m
quick.cut.hint: Default from the settings · the sonde cuts down there automatically
quick.cut.hintChanged: Changed · default from the settings: {def} m AGL · the sonde cuts down there automatically
quick.air.okRes: no conflict up to {alt} m AGL
quick.air.conflict: Airspace {name} from {alt} m AMSL – lower the cutdown to {cut} m AGL?
quick.air.conflictNoFix: Airspace {name} from {alt} m AMSL – no sensible cutdown altitude is left below it. Change the start site («Plan in full instead») or carry on knowingly.
quick.air.unchecked: Airspace not checked – check DABS/NOTAM yourself.
quick.air.note: The app checks wind and airspaces automatically. DABS/NOTAM stay your job.
quick.go.note: Writes cutdown altitude and radio settings to the sonde, reads them back and checks GPS, battery, sensors and the cutdown wire – all automatic. Takes 1–2 minutes.
quick.go.needSonde: Step 1 first: connect receiver and sonde.
quick.go.airText: The sonde would fly through airspace {name} from {alt} m AMSL. Start anyway? You confirm that you have checked the airspace and are aware of the risks.
quick.st.check.s: Wind and airspaces are being checked for the start site. Keep holding the sonde.
quick.st.program.s: Cutdown altitude and radio settings are being written to the sonde and read back. Keep holding the sonde.
quick.st.wire.s: Keep holding the sonde – the string is not cut.
quick.st.gps.t: WAIT – sonde is searching for GPS
quick.st.gps.s: Hold the sonde outdoors, antenna pointing down. This takes 0.5 to 2 minutes. Do not let go. ({have} of {need} satellites)
quick.st.rxgps.t: WAIT – receiver is searching for GPS
quick.st.rxgps.s: Put the receiver outdoors with a clear view of the sky. Do not let go of the sonde.
quick.st.sensors.s: Temperature, humidity, pressure and battery are not plausible yet – wait a few seconds. Do not let go.
quick.st.radio.t: WAIT – radio link to the sonde
quick.st.radio.s: Establish the radio link: keep the RR4 connected, sonde switched on, distance under 50 m. Do not let go.
quick.st.ready.s: The sonde still blinks 2× every 5 s. Once it blinks 1× per second it is ready. Do not let go.
quick.st.go.s: The sonde blinks 1× per second. The app notices the launch by itself and switches to the live view.
quick.st.noRx.s: Plug the USB cable into the RR4 and press «Connect» (step 1).
quick.st.wireBad.s: Check the wire connection, otherwise send the sonde back or use another wire. Then press the button above again.
quick.st.wireError.s: The sonde did not answer the test. Check radio and cable, then press the button above again.
quick.st.battery.s: The sonde reports {v} V. Charge the sonde or use a charged one.
quick.st.settings.t: ERROR – settings on the sonde do not match
quick.st.settings.s: The sonde does not report the chosen cutdown altitude back. Press the button above again.
quick.st.programFailed.s: Cutdown altitude and radio settings could not be written to the sonde. Check radio and cable, then press the button above again.
quick.st.stalled.t: Sonde is not rising yet – did you let go?
quick.st.stalled.s: The app detects the launch from 35 m above ground. Let go of the sonde; if it still does not rise, check balloon and fill.
quick.notify.later: Notify observers via WhatsApp → only after «Program & release»
quick.foot: Everything is logged and saved as files (Dropbox) · observers with a code see the ascent in s2stueve.
quick.live.okTitle: OK – sonde is rising, everything runs automatically
quick.live.okSub: Cutdown at {alt} m above ground in ≈ {min} min. You do not need to do anything. Data goes live to s2stueve and is recorded as files.
quick.live.okSubNoEta: Cutdown at {alt} m above ground. You do not need to do anything. Data goes live to s2stueve and is recorded as files.
quick.live.okSubNoCut: No automatic cutdown – use CUTDOWN NOW if needed. Data goes live to s2stueve and is recorded as files.
quick.live.stalledSub: No climb rate above 0.3 m/s for 30 s. Is the sonde caught somewhere, or has the balloon lost its lift? Use CUTDOWN NOW if needed.
quick.cutNote: Only if needed – asks once, the sonde acknowledges by radio, it is logged.
quick.land.title: Sonde landed – {dist} km from here, bearing {brg}
quick.land.sub: Radio is weak on the ground: take the receiver along and leave it switched on.
quick.hdr.radioGood: Radio good · last packet {s} s ago
quick.hdr.radioWeak: Radio weak · last packet {s} s ago
quick.hdr.radioLost: No radio · last packet {s} s ago
quick.go.needFix: Start is possible only once the receiver knows its position (GPS fix) – put the receiver outdoors.
asc.cutdownDescent: The descent has begun – the cutdown wire is not fired any more.
